messages:
Tara: morning drop-in — quick status: what I did: landed slot allocator fix (PR #412) and ran a microbatch sim against prod trace. Observed a p95 bump on seq512 under high concurrency. Blockers: kv warmup looks flaky (eviction seems to thrash) and I'm not confident in the eviction thresholds. Today: iterate on eviction thresholds, add a couple diagnostic logs to kv manager, and spin a small preprod canary. pinging @Jordan for perf review and @Kim for eviction tuning help.

Lee: saw the PR, will take a look in a bit. can you paste the p95 trace or a quick flame?

Tara: pasting top-line numbers from local run: baseline seq512 p95 ~17.2ms, candidate ~20.6ms. attaching a short stack snapshot in case it's useful.

Jordan: I ran a short bench on the branch (high-concurrency harness): candidate p95 20.6ms vs baseline 17.2ms for seq512, median stable. throughput roughly unchanged. gist: https://gist.github.com/example/bench-snapshot (contains histogram + runner args).

bench-bot: microbench run 2023-05-25T10:30Z — commit abc123: throughput 1.2k req/s, median 3.6ms, p90 8.1ms, p95 20.6ms (seq512, 64 concurrent).

Kim: I can take eviction tuning. hypothesis: low-watermark too high causing aggressive evict/rehydrate loops on long sequences. I'll try lowering low-watermark from 0.6 -> 0.5 and increase the prefetch grace a touch. will add logs:
```
kvmgr: sample_evicted=1 current_util=0.62 target_low=0.5 prefetch_grace_ms=25
```
and push a small change in a separate PR so we can A/B it.

Lee: small FYI — CI hit go vet in runtime/kvmgr on one of the logging changes, left a comment on PR #412. nothing functionally blocking but will need a quick fix.

Tara: thanks — I'll watch CI. plan: if CI green I'll queue the canary to preprod. @Kim coordinate the tuning PR and we'll run benchbot snapshot against canary. also opening an eval run (prompt set) to verify quality.

Jordan: another diagnostic idea: turn off force-prefetch in the kernel for the canary to see if p95 bump disappears (isolates kv path vs kernel batching). we can add a runtime flag: 
```
--kernel.force-prefetch=false
```
If bump disappears it's likely prefetch/slot interaction.

deploy-bot: canary started for commit abc123 on preprod (zone us-west-2) — canary id c-20230525-7.

bench-bot: canary microbench snapshot complete: seq128 p95 6.1ms -> 6.3ms (candidate), seq512 p95 19.4ms -> 20.6ms (candidate). tagging thread with results.

Tara: OK — seems consistent with local. next steps: @Jordan + @Lee if you confirm kernel patch correlates with the bump we can either revert the slot allocator change or land a targeted fix. @Kim will run eviction tuning PR in parallel. I'll hold off broader rollout until bench/eval look good. :thumbsup:

Kim: will post PR and bench results in this thread once ready. low-risk change first.

Lee: will review PR #412 and the tuning PR later today. if no obvious regression path we can try Jordan's preftech flag for a quick narrow canary.

Tara: great — thanks everyone. blocking -> resolved for now (we have a path). ping me if you see a wider regression in staging.
